newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares expect to maintain firm tone.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares expect to maintain firm tone.

text.p: Singapore shares are expected to maintain their firm tone on Tuesday, said dealers.
"Sentiment seems to be more upbeat. Everybody is also looking forward to a good budget this Friday," said a broker with a Singapore firm.
He said the focus would on selected blue chips which have fallen to the lower end of their recent trading ranges like some of the properties and banks.
Small issues will continue to dominate activity. "The is a lot of retail interest in these stocks. As a whole, small caps have also fared much better than blue chips this year," said one analyst.
The Straits Times Industrial index ended at 1,997.99, up 12.05 points on Monday.
